description:
## Status

Absorbed into `fz-tfn.57`. The recursive retraction defect is real, but this ticket's former scheduler-metadata-only source model was false.

Exact job read/output ownership records invalidation and claim ownership. It does not record which independently justified parts of an aggregate a read supports. A surviving key path cannot distinguish:

```text
A = seed union B
B = A
```

after `seed` changes `{x, y}` to `{y}`: every key and an external ground remain present while stale `x` must disappear. A producer that also owns a local constant can present the same read/output transcript while legitimately retaining `x`, so the scheduler cannot infer the answer.

`fz-tfn.57` now owns the atomic boundary that makes this answer knowable: immutable source ownership, accepted replacement, content-specific independent justification, typed-store withdrawal, and blocked/failed attempt completion. The existing World store remains the value authority. Producers retain exact justification for particular contributions before joins erase it; the scheduler routes authoritative movements and never treats reachability, finality, a source-body read, or product retention as semantic support.

`fz-kdt.200` owns the real InputDemand consumer and its final source-owned semantic-question/binding algebra. `LoweredBody` remains the sole operation/value/control denotation. Do not add another flow body, private solver, graph reconstruction, aggregate rollback, or retained generic support authority.

No standalone implementation of the old plan is to land. Its acceptance laws transfer to `.57`: self/mutual cycles; seed remove/replace; independent and shared support; equal publishers; forwarding-edge removal; blocked/failed attempts; typed-store retraction/reappearance; FIFO/LIFO/permuted admission; exact wake causes; and unchanged/unrelated zero work. Its InputDemand cost and private-cone obligations transfer to `.200`.

The falsifying scheduler witness is preserved as recoverable research and becomes a red seed for `.57`; it is not proof that a generic scheduler reachability layer can solve the problem.

comments.text: fz-kdt.199 landed (dd07432db) and its build/2 gate names this ticket as its removal owner, so the split is recorded as a PIN rather than blessed as a law. Measured at the landing: of the executables 199 adds, 36 buy a distinct return and 91 do not (83 on the cold review's 597-fixture comparand). Top offenders: List.reduce_cont/3 (21), List.reduce_while_cont/3 (18), Range.reduce_while_cont/6 (9), reduce_while_step/3 (6) -- all the mutual reduce cycle the self-only subtraction cannot see. Red-first for you: those fall while the 36 bought ones and every ONE_ACTIVATION_KEYING_LAWS row hold, and quicksort stays at 17.
